## 5. High Knee Foreleg Extension - 10 yards down slow, 10 yards back fast

Exercise Objective: Develop strength and range of motion of the hips and knees

## Procedure

1. Perform a small skip by driving left knee up and extending onto toes of right foot (-11a)
2. At the highest point of the skip, extend left knee until entire leg is parallel to the ground (-11b)
3. Keep right knee extended and drive left leg down toward the ground

## Coaching Points

- Maintain a slight forward lean throughout
- The thigh should reach parallel to the ground before extending the foreleg
- Try to make the movement rhythmic
